title: 第1186章 少主回归第1185章 天帝城
content_zh:
整片天地的气息尽数肃穆下来，所有街巷清空闲杂人流，万千灵灯高悬长街，漫天瑞霭流转飘荡，天花乱坠，仙芬弥漫，整座天帝城从上至下，尽数换上迎归盛典的威仪盛况。
天宫正门前的白玉广场之上人山人海，列阵肃然。天庭众官员尽数到场，身着规整仙袍，按品阶文武分列两侧，垂手肃立。各宗门驻城尊者，仙界世袭世家一一在列，冠盖如云，威仪赫赫。广场外围，层层叠叠挤满了天帝城的仙民百姓，人人面露崇敬与欣喜，踮首望向天际，寂静等候，无人喧哗。
不过，最吸引目光的，还是站在百官最前方之人，他就是天帝！
面方耳阔，天庭饱满，双目大而有神，颌线端正沉稳，天生一副至尊福相，自带九五威仪，这就是三界第一人给人的初步印象。他一身帝纹衮龙金袍，身姿挺拔，肩背宽厚端正，周身气度沉凝如山，给人一种莫名的敬畏感。看着他，陆长风想起了一个人——司马苍松。
当然，拿司马苍松类比天帝，实在太过贬低天帝，两人无论修为地位都不在一个层级，只是那股气质很像。陆长风之所以有这种感觉，主要是他初见司马苍松时也是个无名小辈，他当时看司马苍松的感觉和现在看天帝的感觉差不多……
仙舟舱门缓缓开启，清风拂面。当那道熟悉的青年身影走出舱门映入眼帘时，天帝周身凛冽帝威尽数收敛，眼底褪去万里寒凉，只剩真切的温柔与期盼。他上前两步，声音温润厚重，响彻整座广场：“昊儿，爹在这！”
“父帝……”
少主快步走下船来到天帝面前，恭谨行礼：“儿臣，回来了！”
“快起来，你这孩子，几年不见，反倒生分了！”天帝轻轻扶住少主的双臂，目光细细描摹着他的眉眼容貌，上下打量片刻，语气带着心疼与怜惜：“嗯，看着沉稳了不少，可怎么瘦了呢！是神界伙食太寡淡，还是罗德办事不力，未曾将你照料妥当？”
此话一出，舟侧随行的罗德脸色骤然剧变，心头猛地一沉。他这一路提心吊胆，就怕回来遭到问责，没想到怕什么来什么！此刻他哪里敢有半分怠慢，当即快步踏出，双膝重重跪地，姿态恭敬惶恐，高声请罪：“臣失职！未能悉心照料少主，致使少主风霜清减，实属臣之过，请陛下降罪！”
全场瞬间一静，百官尽数敛声屏息，无人敢轻易出声，气氛一时微凝。
“哈哈哈……”天帝忽然朗声大笑，笑意温润坦荡，抬手虚扶一记：“多年不见，你还是老样子，经不起半点玩笑。起来吧，寡人不过随口戏言而已，何须如此惶恐。你这些年恪尽职守，多有建树，此次护昊儿安稳归来，何罪之有？”
罗德心中大石骤然落地，长松一口气，连忙恭敬叩首起身：“谢陛下宽宥！”
一场小小虚惊转瞬消解，君臣气度尽显。待场面平复，下方百官这才齐齐躬身下拜，声浪整齐浩荡，震彻云霄：“恭迎少主平安归城！贺天帝陛下父子团圆，普天同庆，仙界隆昌！”
层层叠叠的朝拜之声连绵不绝，威严壮阔，撼动天地。
外围的仙民百姓再也按捺不住心中的欣喜，压抑已久的欢呼声骤然炸开，如山呼海啸般席卷整座天帝城。
“欢迎少主归来！”
“少主平安回府，实乃仙界之幸！”
万千人声汇聚一处，热烈而不嘈杂，盛大却不显纷乱。无数百姓抬手欢呼，眉眼皆是真挚的喜悦。昭明少主自小就有仁德之名，昔年在天帝城体恤万民，早已深得仙界民心。这几年外放历练，历经波折终于归来，百姓们皆是发自内心的欢欣雀跃。
广场之上，天帝望着身前沉静淡然，眉眼带倦的爱子，眼底暖意更盛，抬手轻轻拍了拍他的肩头，温声再道：“回来便好，回来便好。今日全城同庆，只为迎你归家。”

“谢父帝，儿臣愧不敢当！”
少主微微颔首，心头的郁结与疲惫在这一刻尽数消散大半。
父子重逢，场面温馨感人。除了罗德打了招呼之后，其余随少主归来的吏员都识趣地驻足观看。等这温情时刻过了之后，他们方才上前见礼。这君臣重逢的戏就差了点意思了，少了些温情，多了几分公事的味道，就是一些“众卿辛苦”之类的场面话。
再之后是少主的两位护道人，这两位德高望重，他们见天帝不用跪拜，只是行了个礼。天帝也是对他们彬彬有礼，显然颇为倚重他们。
最后才轮到护卫们……
所有护驾随行少主亲卫齐齐上前一步，整齐划一躬身行礼：“我等恭贺陛下父子团圆，恭迎少主平安归城！”
“诸位辛苦，免礼！”
天帝目光扫过一众护卫，眸光温和赞许。他抬手将面前的林卫扶起，温声开口，声音清朗传遍广场：“小林差事办得不错，昊儿安然归来，不受半分损伤，当记你一功。”
林卫起身垂首，身姿恭肃：“谢陛下，护佑少主，乃是臣之本分，不敢居功。”
“嗯。”天帝微微颔首，面露笑意，环视众人缓声说道：“诸位忠恪履职，不忘初心，实属天庭肱骨之风。今日普天同庆，所有远征神界的爱卿及随行护从皆有功绩，后续自有嘉奖论功行赏。”
“谢陛下！”
一句场面公允之言，落得全场人心安稳。所有归来之人皆是心生敬畏，齐齐躬身谢恩。
话音落下，天帝目光随意一转，掠过林卫身侧，落在了静静跪地的陆长风身上。
“小林，这年轻人是？”
“回陛下，他……”
林卫正要答话，身侧的少主却抢先回道：“父帝，此人名唤张强，是儿臣此番在神界历练途中结识的……朋友。”
“哦，原来是昊儿的朋友，快快起来，让寡人看看。”
正常情况下，天帝叫起来，那陆长风应该说些“谢陛下”，然后顺势起身就对了。可他却将头往地上撞，口中还结结巴巴地喊道：“小民拜见陛下，愿陛下万……那个……万万岁，寿……跟天一样高！”
content_en:
The atmosphere of the whole world has become solemn, all the streets are empty and crowded with people, thousands of spiritual lanterns hang high in the long streets, the sky is full of auspicious mist, the sky is filled with flowers, and the fairy fragrance is filled. The entire Tiandi City from top to bottom is transformed into the majestic grand occasion of the welcome ceremony.
The white jade square in front of the main entrance of the Tiangong is crowded with people, arrayed solemnly. All the officials from the heavenly court were present, dressed in neat immortal robes, lined up on both sides according to rank, civil and military, and stood in awe with their hands down. The venerables of each sect stationed in the city and the hereditary families in the immortal world are listed one by one, with crowns like clouds and majestic appearances. Outside the square, layers upon layers of immortals and common people from Tiandi City were crowded. Everyone showed respect and joy, standing on tiptoe to look at the sky, waiting in silence, no one was making any noise.
However, what attracts the most attention is the person standing at the front of the hundred officials. He is the Emperor of Heaven!
He has a square face, broad ears, full heavenly eyes, big and lively eyes, a straight and steady jaw line, a natural look of supreme blessing, and a majestic appearance. This is the initial impression given by the first person in the Three Realms. He is wearing a gold robe with an imperial pattern and a dragon dragon. He has a tall and straight posture, broad and straight shoulders, and a demeanor as calm as a mountain, giving people an inexplicable sense of awe. Looking at him, Lu Changfeng thought of a person - Sima Cangsong.
Of course, comparing Sima Cangsong to the Emperor of Heaven is too derogatory. The two are not on the same level regardless of their cultivation or status, but they have similar temperaments. The main reason why Lu Changfeng felt this way was that he was an unknown junior when he first met Sima Cansong. The feeling he felt when he saw Sima Cansong at that time was similar to the feeling he feels when he sees the Emperor of Heaven now...
The hatch of the fairy boat slowly opened, and the breeze blew on my face. When the familiar young figure walked out of the cabin door and came into view, the Emperor's fierce imperial power was completely restrained, and the coldness of thousands of miles disappeared from his eyes, leaving only true tenderness and expectation. He took two steps forward, and his voice was warm and deep, resounding throughout the square: "Hao'er, dad is here!"
"Father..."
The young master quickly stepped off the boat and came to the Emperor of Heaven. He bowed respectfully: "My son, I'm back!"
"Get up, you kid, we haven't seen each other for several years, but we've become estranged!" The Emperor gently held the young master's arms and carefully traced his features. He looked up and down for a moment, and said with distress and pity in his tone: "Well, you look a lot calmer, but why have you lost weight? Is it because the food in the God Realm is too meager, or is it because Rhodes didn't do things well and didn't take good care of you?"
As soon as these words came out, the expression of Rhodes who was accompanying him on the boat suddenly changed drastically, and his heart sank suddenly. He was on tenterhooks all the way, fearing that he would be punished when he came back. He didn't expect what he was afraid of would happen! He didn't dare to be careless at this moment, so he stepped out quickly, knelt down heavily on his knees, with a respectful and frightened posture, and loudly apologized: "I have neglected my duty! I failed to take good care of the young master, which caused the young master to suffer from bad weather. It is really my fault. Please forgive me!"
The whole place fell silent for a moment, all the officials held their breaths, no one dared to speak easily, and the atmosphere was slightly condensed for a moment.
"Hahaha..." The Emperor of Heaven suddenly laughed loudly, with a warm and magnanimous smile, and raised his hand to make a gesture: "I haven't seen you for many years, and you are still the same. You can't stand the slightest joke. Get up, I'm just joking casually, why should you be so scared. You have done your duty over the years and have made many achievements. This time, you have protected Hao'er and returned safely. What's the crime?"
Rhodes' heart suddenly fell to the ground, he breathed a long sigh of relief, and quickly kowtowed respectfully and stood up: "Thank you for your forgiveness, Your Majesty!"
A small false alarm was dispelled in an instant, and the magnanimity of the monarch and his ministers was fully displayed. After the scene calmed down, all the officials below bowed down and bowed in unison, with a loud and powerful voice that shook the sky: "Welcome the young master to return safely to the city! Congratulations to His Majesty the Emperor of Heaven for the reunion of his father and son, and the whole world is celebrating, and the immortal world is prosperous!"
The sounds of worshiping are endless, majestic and majestic, shaking the heaven and the earth.
The surrounding immortal people could no longer suppress the joy in their hearts, and the cheers that had been suppressed for a long time suddenly exploded, sweeping through the entire Tiandi City like a mountain roar and a tsunami.
"Welcome back, young master!"
"Young Master returned home safely, it is truly a blessing to the immortal world!"
Thousands of voices gathered in one place, warm and livelyNoisy, grand but not chaotic. Countless people raised their hands and cheered, with sincere joy on their faces. Young Master Zhaoming has a reputation for benevolence since he was a child. In the past, he cared for all the people in Tiandi City and had already won the hearts of the people in the immortal world. In the past few years, he has gone abroad for experience and finally returned after many twists and turns. The people are all happy and excited from the bottom of their hearts.
On the square, the Emperor of Heaven looked at the calm and indifferent beloved son in front of him, with tired brows and eyes, and his eyes were filled with warmth. He raised his hand and patted his shoulder gently, and said in a warm voice: "It will be good to come back, it will be good to come back. The whole city is celebrating today, just to welcome you home."
"Thank you Emperor Father, I am so ashamed of myself!"
The young master nodded slightly, and most of the depression and fatigue in his heart dissipated at this moment.
The reunion of father and son was a warm and touching scene. Except for Rhodes who said hello, the other officials who returned with the young master all stopped to watch with interest. After this tender moment passed, they came forward to greet him. This scene of the reunion of the monarch and his ministers is a little less interesting. It is less tender and more business-like, with some scene-like remarks such as "all the ministers have worked hard".
Then there are the two guardians of the young master. These two are highly respected. They don't need to kneel down when they see the Emperor of Heaven, they just salute. The Emperor of Heaven was also polite to them and obviously relied on them quite a lot.
Finally it was the guards' turn...
All the escorts and personal guards of the young master took a step forward and bowed in unison: "We congratulate your majesty on the reunion of father and son, and welcome the young master back to the city safely!"
"Thank you for your hard work, no courtesy!"
The Emperor's gaze swept across the guards, his eyes gentle and approving. He raised his hand to lift up Lin Wei in front of him, and spoke in a warm voice, the voice clear and clear throughout the square: "Xiao Lin did a good job, Hao'er returned safely without any damage, I will remember you for your contribution."
Lin Wei stood up and bowed his head with a respectful posture: "Thank you, Your Majesty. It is my duty to protect the young master. I dare not take credit."
"Yes." The Emperor of Heaven nodded slightly, with a smile on his face, looked around at everyone and said slowly: "You have performed your duties loyally and faithfully, and have not forgotten your original intention. This is indeed the style of the Heavenly Court. The whole world celebrates today. All the beloved ministers and accompanying guards on the expedition to the God Realm have achieved merit, and there will be rewards in the future."
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
A word that was fair to the situation brought peace to the hearts of the whole audience. All those who returned were in awe and bowed to express their gratitude.
After the words fell, the Emperor's gaze casually turned, passing by Lin Wei's side, and landed on Lu Changfeng, who was kneeling quietly.
"Xiao Lin, who is this young man?"
"Return to Your Majesty, he..."
Lin Wei was about to answer, but the young master beside him responded first: "Father, this person's name is Zhang Qiang. He is a... friend that I met during my experience in the God Realm."
"Oh, it turns out he is Hao'er's friend. Get up quickly and let me have a look."
Under normal circumstances, when the Emperor of Heaven shouted, Lu Changfeng should just say "Thank you, Your Majesty" and then get up. But he banged his head on the ground and stammered in his mouth: "I pay my respects to Your Majesty, I wish Your Majesty to live...that...long live...as high as the sky!"
